controlled.answer:
- [1] § 820.10(b)(2) requires that manufacturers document traceability procedures in accordance with ISO 13485, if applicable, and applies to the requirements of part 821 of this chapter.  
- [2] § 820.10(b)(4) requires that advisory notices be handled in accordance with the requirements of part 806 of this chapter, and applies to the requirements of part 820 of this chapter.  

They share the requirement that quality management system requirements apply to the manufacturer, but differ in the specific advisory notices and the requirements for traceability.
